_what: Saved edit handoff choices for src/editor-handoff.mjs and the shared Send to editor panel. Filmcraft writes its own project through the existing installed-app job owner. Source files are admitted as mounted Namespace references; callers never supply a mount path or force a full download. Unsupported composition changes stop before the job without changing the saved edit. A queued job is distinct from a completed project. frame_rates names the timeline speeds; default marks the initial choice. places and left_out retain historical saved-choice documentation but are not active Filmcraft inputs.

editors.label: Filmcraft
editors.open_steps: Open this project in Filmcraft. Its clips refer to your Namespace files.

places.label: Mac
places.connect_steps: Trillion for Mac fills this from its connected source folder. In a browser, enter the full path to that folder on the computer with your editor.

places.label: Windows
places.connect_steps: In File Explorer choose Map network drive, pick Z:, enter {origin}/dav/ and sign in with any name and a personal key as the password.

places.label: Linux
places.connect_steps: Mount {origin}/dav/ at /mnt/trillion with davfs2, signing in with any name and a personal key as the password.

left_out.source-rate-assumed: Each clip is placed at the timeline's speed; check any clip filmed at another speed.
left_out.source-audio-assumed: Each clip's sound is linked as one track.
left_out.audio-channel-routing-unverified: Each clip's sound is linked as one track.
left_out.clip-transforms-not-translated: Looks, speed and framing on clips are not in the timeline; set them again in your editor.
left_out.captions-not-translated: Captions are not in the timeline; add them again in your editor.
left_out.composition-fields-not-translated: Text on screen and extra layers are not in the timeline; add them again in your editor.
left_out.spine-fields-not-translated: Transitions between clips are not in the timeline.
left_out.render-settings-not-translated: Export settings stay with Trillion's render; choose them again when you export.
left_out.music-mix-not-translated: Music fades and ducking are not in the timeline; set them again in your editor.
left_out.audio-placement-mix-not-translated: Effects on added sound are not in the timeline.
left_out.audio-layers-not-translated: Some sound layers are not in the timeline.
left_out.generated-audio-not-translated: Generated voice or sound is not in the timeline.
left_out.image-placement-transforms-not-translate: Where pictures sit on screen is not in the timeline; place them again in your editor.
left_out.video-placement-transforms-not-translate: Where added videos sit on screen is not in the timeline; place them again in your editor.
left_out.default: Something in this edit is not in the timeline; check it in your editor.
